item.title: MiniNotch 0.8.1
item.description:
Improved

  • Updates Install Themselves: New versions now download and install on their own, once the notch is closed and no timer or stopwatch is running, and What's New tells you what changed. If you chose Ask First before, that stays. To be asked first instead: Settings > About > New Versions > Ask First.
  • Update Window in Front: With Ask First, the window offering a new version now always opens in front of your other apps.

item.title: MiniNotch 0.8.0
item.description:
New

  • The Time in the Notch: A clock beside the camera, in your Mac's 12 or 24 hour time, with the day if you like. Settings > Layout > Closed Pill: drag Clock onto either side, with Show Indicators When Closed on. Clock Shows picks Time or Day and Time.
  • Up Next: A new button beside Next shows what plays after this song. Apple Music shares it for a playlist or album playing in order; for Spotify, connect your account once. The button is added after Next for you; move it in Settings > Layout. Connect Spotify in Settings > Music > Up Next.
  • MiniNotch Has a Website: Every feature, the six Notch Styles, and the easiest way to install, to share with friends. We plan to move it to mininotch.app soon. andrefongkc-cyber.github.io/mininotch

Improved

  • Simpler Settings: Settings is sorted by what you are changing: Music, Lock Screen, Weather, Timer, Shelf & Notes and more. Each section shows what most people change, with the rest under More Options, and search still finds everything. Open Settings from the menu bar icon.
  • Drag Files to the Notch Again: Dragging a file or a link to the closed notch opens the Shelf again, ready to keep it or send it with AirDrop.
  • Play, Pause and Skip Right Away: The buttons answer the moment you click them instead of half a second later, in the notch, the pop-out player and the lock screen.

item.title: MiniNotch 0.7.7
item.description:
New

  • Settings in the Menu Bar: Pin the switches you use most to the menu bar icon's menu, and turn them on and off without opening Settings. Settings > General > Pin Settings to the Menu.
  • Lyrics on Your Choice of Display: Show the lyrics under the closed notch on every display, only the Mac's own, or only the others. The lyrics button on the music card, or Settings > Media > Show Lyrics On.
  • Glow Around the Pop-Out Player: Ambient Lighting now glows around the pop-out music window too, and can light the lyrics under the closed notch on their own. Option-click the effects button on the music card, or Settings > Appearance > Ambient Lighting > Where It Shows.

Improved

  • Opens Again: 0.7.6 could close straight away every time it was opened while the Mac was plugged in, after it had last been quit on battery. Fixed. If 0.7.6 will not open, it cannot update itself: download this version, or open 0.7.6 once with the Mac unplugged and it will update.
  • Glow Menu You Can See: The glow's style and placement menu on the music card opens inside the notch, where it used to be hidden.

item.title: MiniNotch 0.7.6
item.description:
Improved

  • Music Controls Answer Straight Away: With Chrome open and many tabs, the cover, the lyrics and the pause button could take seconds to respond, even in Apple Music. They respond at once again.

item.title: MiniNotch 0.7.5
item.description:
Improved

  • Everything You Missed: If you skip a few versions, this window now lists what came in every one of them, newest first, not only the latest.

Removed

  • Wave and Chase Glow Styles, for Now: They are being reworked and will come back. If you had one picked, the glow now uses Pulse. Settings > Appearance > Ambient Lighting to pick Pulse, Bars or Rainbow Cycle.

item.title: MiniNotch 0.7.4
item.description:
New

  • Clock Styles: Show the timer and stopwatch as a flip clock, or as a mechanical seven-segment display whose segments flip over or slide out, in the notch and the pop-out window. The style button at the top of the Timer tab, beside Focus.
  • Every Lap: The stopwatch lists all your laps beside the time, the current one ticking, the fastest in green and the slowest in red. The .00 button shows or hides hundredths.
  • Bigger Pop-Out Timer: Expand the pop-out timer, or drag its edges, and the time grows with it. Hover the pop-out window and click the expand button, top left.
  • Apps Using the Battery: See which apps have used the most energy since you unplugged. Settings > Battery > Battery Use.
  • Install Updates Automatically: Choose to have new versions install by themselves, once the notch is closed and no timer is running, or keep being asked first. Settings > About > New Versions.

Improved

  • Stopwatch in the Closed Notch: A running stopwatch shows in the closed notch, as a countdown does.
  • External Displays in Layout: The settings for the notch on displays without one now sit in Settings > Layout, under the Closed Pill, and searching "monitor" finds them.
  • Menus in the Notch: The top bar's What's New button and the clock style button open their menus inside the notch, where they can be seen and clicked.
  • Smoother Stopwatch: The stopwatch counts every hundredth, and slows to tenths in Low Power Mode or on a low battery.

item.title: MiniNotch 0.7.3
item.description:
New

  • Stopwatch: The Timer tab is now a timer or a stopwatch, with laps. Switch between them at the top of the tab. The Timer tab: Timer | Stopwatch, top left.
  • Pop-Out Timer: Float the timer or stopwatch in a small window above your other apps, and put it back when you are done. The Timer tab's pop-out button, top right.
  • Focus: Turn on Focus and the timer pops out when it starts. Switch to another app while a countdown, a Pomodoro focus interval or the stopwatch runs, and it starts over. Breaks and pauses do not count. Focus at the top of the Timer tab, or Settings > Tabs > Timer > Focus Timer.

Improved

  • Tidier Timer Tab: Choose a Pomodoro rhythm, then press Start: picking a rhythm no longer starts it. Quick countdowns and your own length sit on one row below.
  • Scrolling Stays Put: Scrolling the Clipboard list or Notes no longer closes the notch, however short they are.

item.title: MiniNotch 0.7.2
item.description:
New

  • Lock Screen Player: While your Mac is locked, what is playing shows in the middle of the screen: the cover, its controls, and the synced lyrics sliding along with the song. Settings > Media > Lock Screen. Pick a layout, or keep the small strip under the notch.
  • Spotify in Chrome: Now Playing picks up Spotify's web player in Google Chrome. For the cover, the time, the buttons and lyrics, Chrome has to allow it once. In Chrome: View > Developer > Allow JavaScript from Apple Events.
  • Panel Size: Small, Medium, Large, a width of your own, or Fit to Top Bar, which narrows the panel when you have fewer tabs. The music card's text and controls scale with it. Settings > Appearance > Panel Size.

Improved

  • Settings Opens Again: 0.7.1 closed as soon as Settings was opened; fixed. MiniNotch also checks for updates every 3 hours now, or as often as you like, from every hour to once a week. Settings > About > How Often.
  • One Place for Every Tab: Settings has a Tabs pane with the Shelf, links, Timer, Weather, Notes, Clipboard and System settings together. Settings > Tabs.
  • Tidier Music Card: Play sits in the middle of the controls, the title is a little smaller, and lyrics are found for more songs whose length differs slightly.
  • Steadier Notch: The notch stays put when you swipe between desktops, the top bar's icons clear the camera, and Default Tab applies every time the notch opens.

item.title: MiniNotch 0.7.0
item.description:
New

  • Notch Styles: Six looks for the notch: Minimal, Bento, Glass, Neumorphic, Clay and Skeuomorphic, each in dark, light, or Auto to follow your Mac. Minimal Dark is the notch you know. Settings > Appearance > Notch Style.
  • Liquid Glass: Any style can sit on Apple's Liquid Glass, see-through and bending what is behind the notch. Glass Opacity sets how clear it is, from glass to nearly solid. Needs macOS 26. Settings > Appearance > Notch Style > Background.
  • Automatic Updates: MiniNotch now checks for a new version once a day and asks before installing it. This is the last version you have to download by hand. Check now from the menu bar icon, or switch it off in Settings > About.
  • Private Clipboard: The Clipboard tab stays blurred until you unlock it with Touch ID or your password, and blurs again when it closes. Anything copied in the Passwords app or Keychain Access is never kept. On by default. Switch it off in Settings > Advanced > Blur Until Unlocked.

Improved

  • Smoother Swipes: Two-finger swipes work anywhere on the open notch, quick flicks count, the direction is right with Natural Scrolling off, and the notch resizes along with the tab you swipe to.
  • Lighter While Playing: Much less work for your Mac while music plays, which you would have felt in Mission Control and with Settings open. The open notch also closes when you switch desktops.
